## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** Chimú考古一个长期结构性问题是盗墓：大量精美金属器、纺织品和装饰品很早进入收藏与艺术市场，却失去了埋葬组合、人体关系和墓葬使用过程。Chan Chan这座墓最重要的不是“有很多贵重器物”，而是保存了近乎完整的原始情境，使精英身份、多人埋葬、墓室使用、祖先实践和随葬品组合可以一起研究。

**English.** A structural problem in Chimú archaeology is looting. Many spectacular metal objects, textiles, and ornaments entered collections without their burial associations, human remains, or depositional histories. The Chan Chan tomb therefore matters not because it contains “treasure,” but because it preserves context: elite identity, multiple burials, tomb use, ancestor practices, and grave-good associations can be studied together.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 2026年在Chan Chan的Utzh An围墙建筑群南墙外侧、紧贴墙体的位置发现一座大型Chimú墓葬平台，保存至少38名个体及金属、贝壳、石英饰物和武器等随葬品。主持研究的Jorge Meneses明确指出，这不是“原封未动”的一次性埋葬，而是**次生墓葬情境**：部分遗骸在死后被家族成员或墓地管理者反复移动和重新安置，但没有系统盗墓迹象。墓中还包括一具较为罕见的伸直葬个体，与Chimú常见的屈肢或坐姿屈肢葬不同。官方和研究团队也提出个别个体可能涉及人祭，但目前仍是待进一步检验的解释。

**English.** In 2026, archaeologists uncovered a large Chimú funerary platform immediately outside and against the southern wall of the Utzh An walled compound at Chan Chan. It contained at least 38 individuals together with metal objects, shell, quartz ornaments, weapons and other grave goods. Jorge Meneses, the archaeologist directing the investigation, explicitly described this as a **secondary funerary context**, not a sealed untouched burial: some remains had been repeatedly moved and rearranged after death by relatives or cemetery attendants, while there was no evidence of systematic looting. One individual was buried fully extended, an unusual treatment compared with more typical Chimú flexed or seated-flexed burials. Officials and researchers have also raised the possibility that some individuals may represent human sacrifice, but that interpretation remains preliminary.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 这项发现最重要的地方不是“未被扰动”，而是墓葬在未遭盗墓破坏的情况下保存了复杂的**持续性葬仪操作**。遗骸反复移动说明墓葬平台可能长期参与家族纪念、祖先实践或墓地管理，而不是一次性封闭。平台位于Utzh An围墙之外但紧邻南墙，因此Meneses认为墓主和被葬者应属于Chimú社会中的重要人物，却**未必是统治者**。这种空间位置、多人埋葬和非典型伸直葬，为理解Chan Chan精英等级、祖先实践和墓葬管理提供了比“宝物发现”更重要的证据。

**English.** The discovery matters not because it was completely undisturbed, but because it preserves a complex history of **continued mortuary manipulation without systematic looting**. Repeated movement of human remains suggests that the platform remained active in family commemoration, ancestor practices or cemetery management rather than being sealed after a single burial episode. Because it lies outside but directly against the southern wall of Utzh An, Meneses argues that the principal individuals were socially important, though **not necessarily rulers**. The spatial setting, multiple burials and unusual extended interment therefore provide stronger evidence for Chimú hierarchy, ancestor practice and mortuary management than a simple “treasure tomb” narrative.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

**尚无同行评议论文 | No peer-reviewed publication yet.**

Ministerio de Cultura del Perú. (2026, September 8). *Gran hallazgo de una plataforma funeraria en Chan Chan revela nuevas evidencias sobre la élite Chimú*. https://www.gob.pe/institucion/ddclalibertad/noticias/1443909-gran-hallazgo-de-una-plataforma-funeraria-en-chan-chan-revela-nuevas-evidencias-sobre-la-elite-chimu

Agencia Peruana de Noticias Andina. (2026). *Peru: Funerary platform with 38 high-status individuals uncovered at Chan Chan*. https://andina.pe/ingles/noticia-peru-funerary-platform-with-38-highstatus-individuals-uncovered-at-chan-chan-1090968.aspx

Agencia Peruana de Noticias Andina. (2026). *Peru: Chan Chan funerary platform reveals Chimu elite rituals 600 years ago*. https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-peru-chan-chan-funerary-platform-reveals-chimu-elite-rituals-600-years-ago-1091732.aspx

**现有资料内容（中文）。** 官方新闻稿确认墓葬平台、38名个体及丰富随葬品；Andina对Jorge Meneses的采访进一步明确了次生墓葬情境、反复移动遗骸、平台位于Utzh An南墙外侧以及墓主“重要但未必是统治者”等关键信息。现阶段应以这些官方和一手采访资料为依据，不再使用无法核实的“初步报告”题名。

**What the current sources show (English).** The Ministry of Culture release documents the funerary platform, 38 individuals and associated grave goods. Andina's interviews with Jorge Meneses add the crucial interpretation of a secondary funerary context, repeated post-mortem manipulation, the platform's location outside the southern wall of Utzh An, and the conclusion that the principal individuals were important but not necessarily rulers. These official and first-hand interview sources replace the previously unverified “preliminary report” citation.
